heading: Films made entirely with AI
intro: Our in-house AI pipeline doesn't just localize and market films — it makes them. Original stories, generated and crafted frame by frame, heading to release.

items.title: Karma
items.synopsis: Every action returns. Karma is a full-length feature crafted end-to-end with our generative AI filmmaking pipeline — characters, environments and visual effects produced without a traditional camera. A glimpse of cinema's next chapter, now in final production.
